content.text: All ops are valid and the eight provisions are covered. Now I'm assembling the proposal set and validating it.

statements.text: ADD-03 Note (2) to Table 1-1 (second revision) amends the VOL-I 11.2 weighting to 70% technical / 30% commercial.

evidence.words: The combined score weighting stated in Volume I Clause 11.2 is amended to seventy per cent (70%) technical and thirty per cent (30%) commercial.

statements.text: At ADD-02, VOL-I 11.2 reads 65% technical / 35% commercial (as amended by ADD-02).

evidence.words: sixty-five per cent (65%) technical and thirty-five per cent (35%) commercial

statements.text: At ADD-02, VOL-I 11.3 sets the threshold as 70 marks out of 100 and returns Envelope B unopened.

evidence.words: A Proposal scoring less than seventy (70) marks out of one hundred (100) at the technical evaluation shall not proceed to commercial evaluation and its Envelope B shall be returned unopened.

statements.text: Table 1-1 (second revision) in ADD-03 totals 120 marks.
calculate threshold_of_total: 70% of 120 marks = 84 marks (not rounded; the pack states no rounding rule).

evidence.words: less than seventy per cent (70%) of the total marks available in Table 1-1

statements.text: ADD-03:6.2 deletes VOL-I 11.3 and replaces it with a new 11.3 and a new 11.3A.

evidence.words: Volume I Clause 11.3 is deleted and replaced by the following two Clauses

statements.text: Note (1) says the threshold is 'unchanged at seventy per cent (70%)', but the threshold in marks rises: it was 70 marks out of 100 (VOL-I 11.3 at ADD-02) and becomes 70% of the 120 marks in the second-revision Table 1-1, i.e. 84 marks. items.model_rationale: I looked at the image. Its Arabic note at the foot (right-to-left, two lines) says the form must be submitted in Arabic for each consortium member and the Arabic text is authoritative, which matches 8.2. The reading is still 'pending'.

payload.text: The Arabic and English versions of Form 4-H disagree on the beneficial-ownership threshold. The governing Arabic (Appendix A, decl1) says ten per cent (١٠٪ / 10%); the English (p.5) says twenty-five per cent (25%). 8.2 makes the Arabic govern, so each member must disclose every natural person holding 10% or more of its capital or voting rights. Preparing to the English 25% risks an incomplete Form 4-H, which is non-responsive under 8.4. Consider a clarification to the Authority; meanwhile prepare to 10%.
